_comment: Tool selectors. A selector keeps the tools of its type, in library order, for which every `keep` condition holds, checked in order; the first that fails turns the tool down, with `else_reject` saying why where it is given. Then it prefers the first kept, or the largest by a value, ties going to the first or the last in library order. Expressions are arithmetic and comparisons over the selector's inputs, its `let` values, the library's values (drill_tolerance_mm), step2cam's constants (tip_clearance_mm) and the tool's fields (`tool.diameter`). A tool field that is missing or not a number fails every comparison, so that tool is not chosen.

selectors.description: The drill closest to the diameter and never larger, at most drill_tolerance_mm under it.
The largest end mill that fits inside the diameter with room to helix.
The largest end mill narrower than the width whose flutes reach the depth.
The widest sharp V-bit no wider than the channel's angle: a wider one would cut its walls, a flat tip could not reach the root.
The first 90° chamfer mill wide enough for the width with its tip clear of the edge.
The largest thread mill whose pitch range takes the pitch, that fits the drilled hole, whose neck clears the crests and that reaches the thread's bottom.

keep.else_reject: {tool.id}: its ⌀{tool.neck_diameter:raw} neck would rub the thread crests
{tool.id}: reaches {reach} mm, the thread ends {below:r} mm below the stock top
